user.title: Connect to TelltaleDNS
user.description: Create an API token in TelltaleDNS (Settings → Users → API tokens). An agent token with analytics:read and config:read is enough to watch; add ops:pause for the blocking switches, ops:anomalies to acknowledge findings, and config:write:clients to quarantine devices.

data_description.url: The web address of any node, for example http://192.0.2.53:8053.

reauth_confirm.title: TelltaleDNS needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} stopped working (it was revoked or expired). Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: TelltaleDNS didn't answer at that address.
error.missing_scope: The token can't read the node: give it the analytics:read scope.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong; see the log.

abort.already_configured: This TelltaleDNS node or cluster is already set up.

data.pause_minutes: Minutes a blocking switch pauses for
data.quarantine_group: Group a quarantined device goes into
data.anomaly_events: Fire telltale_anomaly events for new device anomalies

data_description.pause_minutes: Agent tokens may pause for at most 60 minutes.
data_description.quarantine_group: Create this group in TelltaleDNS first (for example with a block_all schedule that never ends).

acknowledge_anomalies.description: Mark device anomaly findings as seen in TelltaleDNS.
